single_slot_selection: smallest numeric PMID satisfying predicate; equal PMID uses earliest fixed query rank
baseline_selection: 31452104 is additional fixed BASE, not automatically added to the candidate set for other slots
meta_selection: target is the subset of the 16-field vocabulary actually available in the fixed candidate pool; exact minimum-cardinality set cover; ties use numerically ascending PMID tuples in lexicographic order; vocabulary fields absent from the candidate union are separately reported as untested coverage gaps, not additional prerequisites
absent_fields_selection: exact minimum-cardinality set covering absence of each field; numeric ascending PMID tuple lexicographic tie-break
full_text_evidence: official ELink llinks Full Text Sources URLs/attributes plus structured PMC identifier; never infer absence solely from DOI absence
free_predicate: PMC identifier or full-text LinkOut explicitly marked free resource
publisher_predicate: official non-library full-text provider link not marked free and no known free source; access price is not inferred
abstract_only_predicate: nonempty abstract; successful per-ID LinkOut response; zero Full Text Sources URLs; no PMC identifier
relationship_selection: batch acheck first, select numeric-min candidate for requested linkname availability/absence, then confirm neighbor response excluding self; inconsistency is missing prerequisite, not silent replacement
library3_selection: BASE,DOI,FREE deduplicated in order; supplement numerical ascending candidates until three distinct PMIDs
library55_selection: first 55 distinct IDs in the diabetes ESearch response's publication-date order
missing_slot_policy: missing prerequisite; do not expand candidates, fabricate record, or select based on application behavior
raw_payload_policy: original XML and complete abstract/record data stay in local ignored rawcache; public manifest contains bibliographic metadata, presence booleans, source request provenance and hashes
clarification_authority: Parent and specification agent clarified 8-query count, current sort parameter mapping, exact META set-cover targets and LIBRARY55/LIBRARY3 before any application evaluation execution; formal 100 tests are unchanged.
